turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for contacting AcmeBrands! How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I am trying to use your website, but it is running so lowly that it's not usable.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: running so slowly

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry you're having issues with our website. Is it the whole website?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, the whole thing won't work right.

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Agent is looking for solutions ...

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Try logging out of your account and then back in to see if it improves.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ok, I'll try it.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I tried it, but it's still doing the same thing.

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Agent is looking for solutions ...

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay. Can you visit another website and let me know if it's working. It may be more than just our website and could be your internet connection.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Let me check.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Other websites are working fine.

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Agent is looking for solutions ...

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Try closing all other browser tabs and any programs that are running in the background. Then try our website again please.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ok, I'll try.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That seemed to have worked, and it seems to be working ok now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great! Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that was all!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I hope you enjoy the rest of your day!
